skill_name: Analyze how urbanization has changed culture in a city you are familiar with.
workflow: Urbanization has had a profound effect on the culture of my city, Seattle. It has led to the emergence of diverse neighborhoods that reflect the many facets of life in the city. For example, the increasing number of tech companies in the city has resulted in the growth of the South Lake Union district, a hub of activity with trendy restaurants, bars, shops, and high-rises.
